preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within bounds 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 0 ≤ t_i ≤ n-1 for each course dependency count.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) >= 2 and all(x.isdigit() for x in stdin.split()[:2])
preconditions.description: First line contains exactly two integers n and k.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + 2 and all(len(line.split()) >= 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Input has exactly n+2 lines: first line for n and k, second line for k main courses, and n lines for course dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(course) <= n for course in stdin.splitlines()[1].split())
preconditions.description: All k main courses are distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(dep) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] for dep in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All dependency course numbers are distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) == len(line.split()) - 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each course dependency line starts with t_i, followed by exactly t_i distinct dependency course numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.count('\n') == 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid order exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, first line is integer m (number of courses), and second line is m distinct integers in chronological order, all between 1 and n.
All k main courses are included in the output sequence if a valid order exists.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all((int(course) not in [int(dep) for dep in line.split()[1:]] or int(course) in [int(x) for x in stdout.split()[1:][:i]]) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[2:], 1) for course in [int(line.split()[0])])
postconditions.description: For every course in the output sequence, all its dependencies appear before it in the sequence.
The number of courses in the output sequence matches the first line's integer m.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (stdout.strip() != '-1' and not any(int(course) in [int(dep) for dep in line.split()[1:]] for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[2:], 1) for course in [int(line.split()[0])] if int(course) not in [int(x) for x in stdout.split()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, no course is included in the output sequence unless it is a main course or a dependency of a main course (transitively).
